spec: PILLS_TO_GLASSBOWL_CONSOLIDATE.md — fold every loose Glassbowl control into the shared ⋯ pill registry.
registry: pill_builder.js (used as-is — same renderer as erp.html/idempiere.html, NO second framework)
note: SIBLING manifest for the Glassbowl surface (glassbowl.html, GENERATED by scripts/system_explorer.js). fn bound BY ID in glassbowl_pills.js to the REAL existing host handlers (window.GlassbowlPillActions). icon = a glyph in icons.js (verbatim Lucide); nothing inlined, nothing hand-drawn. Retires the hand-rolled .ctl bar + the loose about/qr/needHelp controls (§PILL-REGISTRY: no controls outside the pill).

pills.name: Home — back to ERP
pills.note: navigate to erp.html (always return to the app).

pills.name: Trace a record
pills.note: toggle trace mode — follow a record through its connected documents.

pills.name: Untangle
pills.note: spread bunched lines apart — angular declutter (bubbles stay movable).

pills.name: Reset view
pills.note: re-home the bubbles + camera to the at-rest layout.

pills.name: Info panel
pills.note: hide / show the side info panel (lit = open).

pills.name: World History
pills.note: HISTORY_KNOB_DIAL.md — TAP = the cross-page History overlay; LONG-PRESS = drawer with Z (this page's view-log timeline) + bomb (clear history, warns first). Replaces the bottom-left clock launcher (WholeHistory mounts {launcher:false}).

pills.name: Edit (CRUD ring)
pills.note: open the CRUD ring-of-fire on the focused record (crud_overlay).

pills.name: Scan QR
pills.note: scan a record's QR — no typing (opens the camera).

pills.name: ShowMe / Need Help
pills.note: toggle the shared help_overlay NeedHelp guide (lit = on) — same Help affordance as the other pages.
